description: Election Commission - Poll Gazette - Parliament Election 2020 ; (Names of Political Parites,  Preferential Numbers & Polling Stations)
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about parliamentary elections, specifically detailing the order of political parties and independent groups on ballot papers, candidate names and their preferential numbers, and polling station information for electoral districts. It is a notice issued by the Election Commission under the Parliamentary Elections Act, making it a clear example of an Elections Gazette.
